meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Team-first maximum-saturation research orchestration for omo-senpi. Scopes solo, ALWAYS asks which final format to render (PDF+DOCX default), then stands up a max-size cooperating team (team_create): one member per axis plus skeptic/red-team members for ultradebate/hyperdebate cross-critique, explore/librarian lanes, live ulw-loop journaling, an EXPAND loop until leads run dry, claims proven by code or the claim-graph gate, and a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid/assets behind visual-QA and `writing` proofread gates. ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user demand for research: the word 'ulw-research' ('/ulw-research', '$ulw-research'), any 'ulw' research wording, 'ultradebate' or 'hyperdebate' research requests, or an explicit request for research / deep research / an ultra-precise investigation, in any language. Never self-activates for ordinary questions, debugging, or implementation context-gathering. While active it overrides exploration-bounding defaults: exhaustive coverage is the goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调度多名AI助手分工协作,完成穷尽式调研并输出综合报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要就复杂议题做系统深入的研究并得到带引用的结论
copy.tagline_en: Direct a team of AI agents to run exhaustive research and deliver a synthesis report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need systematic deep research on complex topics with cited conclusions

howto.what: 用户明确要求研究时,它先自行界定问题范围并询问输出格式(默认 PDF+DOCX),再组建最多 8 人的团队按轴分工、让质疑者互相辩论,穷尽线索后产出逐条带引用、含图表/Mermaid 的合成报告,并过视觉与写作校对两道关。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做研究时触发(任何语言),例如说出“ulw-research”、“ultradebate”等关键词,或直接要求“研究/深度研究/超精密调查”;普通提问、调试、收集上下文不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 研究 RAG 最新进展,输出 PDF+DOCX
say.note: 它会先确认输出格式再组队研究。

say.text: 启动 ultradebate:对比 Postgres 与 MySQL 并发控制
say.note: 质疑者会交叉攻击,收敛后给结论。

say.text: 做深度研究,验证这个代码库里的性能断言
say.note: 它会用代码验证并生成带引用的报告。

howto.what_en: On explicit research demand, it scopes, asks format (default PDF+DOCX), creates an 8-member team (axis owners + skeptics), expands until leads dry, and delivers a cited synthesis with charts/Mermaid after visual QA and writing proofread.
howto.when_en: Activates only when the user requests research (e.g. 'ulw-research', 'ultradebate', or 'deep research') in any language. Ordinary questions, debugging, and context-gathering do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Use ulw-research to investigate the latest RAG advances and output PDF+DOCX.
say_en.note: It confirms the format, then starts the research team.

say_en.text: Start an ultradebate: compare Postgres and MySQL concurrency controls.
say_en.note: Skeptics cross-examine claims before the verdict.

say_en.text: Do deep research verifying the performance claims in this codebase.
say_en.note: It runs code checks and produces a cited report.
